title: Softstep Burst
generation_prompt: Produce one ORIGINAL 128-second stereo FUTURE BASS instrumental for an all-ages one-or-two-key rhythm game at STRICT constant 110 BPM in 4/4. The full beat begins at time zero: short clear kick on EVERY quarter beat, dry snare on beats two and four, crisp eighth-note hats, a separate short soft-mallet synth attack on EVERY quarter beat, round bouncing bass and warm chord pulses all at stable audible level through 128 seconds. No ambient intro, slow build, percussion dropout, half-time switch, quiet bridge, fade, filtered outro, silent ending or tempo drift. Signature hook: two light descending notes step toward each other, then a bright five-note rising burst answers; short releases make every attack clear for charting. Use colorful but gentle sidechained chords that never bury the kick or lead. At 64 seconds retain the same drum grid and volume, change bass roots, trade the two-note and five-note positions, and add fresh syncopated replies to the final beat. Playful, spacious, controlled highs and bass, no abrasive distortion. No vocals, speech, samples, familiar melody or imitation of another song.
cover_prompt: Create one original SQUARE 1:1 duohertz cover for Softstep Burst, an all-ages future-bass rhythm-game track. Use near-black ink, warm-ivory cut-paper shapes, coral red, electric cyan and sparse comic-print halftone. Main motif: exactly TWO simplified WARM-IVORY FOOTPRINT silhouettes stepping diagonally upward toward each other; each footprint has one broad heel and three rounded toe cutouts, clear as an abstract dance step rather than realistic human anatomy. ONE electric-cyan stepped soundline links the heels and jumps outward at the upper right as three short coral rectangular beat bursts. Keep both full footprints and bursts inside the central 55% of the square for a narrow 100px mobile card, with dark lower fifth for local title overlay. Bold flat print graphics, child-friendly, distinct from keycaps, shoes, arrows and paper planes. No people, scenery, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, strobe or copied game art.
og_prompt: Edit the supplied original Softstep Burst square cover into a HORIZONTAL roughly 1.9:1 duohertz social card. Preserve exactly TWO warm-ivory stylized footprint silhouettes stepping diagonally toward each other, one cyan stepped soundline linking the heels and three short coral beat bursts. Recompose all of the motif on the RIGHT half over near-black comic-print ink with sparse halftone; leave quiet dark space on the LEFT. Add exactly two crisp fully legible English lines on the left: 'duohertz' lowercase electric cyan and 'Softstep Burst' larger warm ivory. Spell both exactly without truncation. Purpose-build wide composition, do not stretch square. No other words, numbers, people, scenery, logo, watermark or copied game art.
